description: Source code for MediaFoundationTexturePool class managing texture pooling for video rendering on Windows using Direct3D 11.

classes.name: MediaFoundationFrameInfo
classes.description: Holds information about a media frame, including a handle and token.

classes.name: MediaFoundationTexturePool::TextureInfo
classes.description: Represents a texture and its usage state within the pool.

classes.name: MediaFoundationTexturePool
classes.description: Manages a pool of textures for media rendering, including initialization, acquisition, and release.

methods.name: MediaFoundationTexturePool::Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the texture pool by creating textures and shared handles.

methods.name: MediaFoundationTexturePool::AcquireTexture
methods.description: Provides an available texture from the pool and marks it as in use.

methods.name: MediaFoundationTexturePool::ReleaseTexture
methods.description: Releases a texture back into the pool, marking it as available.
